{"reason": "v1's 20 false arbitrations (rate 0.714) are mostly low-confidence events (0.44-0.67). Adding (high-confidence? edi-change) gates on confidence >= 0.7, suppressing those rows; recall should hold at 1.0 since every costly row was a false positive, not a miss, and exposure/pct/frozen guards stay unchanged.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
